title: Distinct constant-field sheets have disjoint ranges
statement: Let \(k_0\subset k_1\) be finite fields, \(r\in\mathbf N\) satisfy \(\#k_1=(\#k_0)^r\), and let \(X/k_0\) and \(C/k_1\) be schemes. Write \(\bar X=X\times_{k_0}\bar k_0\), \(\bar C=C\times_{k_1}\bar k_1\), with scheme projections \(p_X,p_C\) and closure projections \(b_X,b_C\). Let \(\tau:\bar k_1\simeq_{k_0}\bar k_0\) be the chosen algebraic-closure isomorphism `algebraicClosureAlgEquiv k₀ k₁`, \(c:C\to X\) a monomorphism, and \(v:\bar C\to\bar X\) a map satisfying \(p_X\circ v=c\circ p_C\) and \(b_X\circ v=\operatorname{Spec}(\tau^{-1})\circ b_C\). For each \(n\in\mathbf N\) with \(r\nmid n\), the ranges of \(v\) and \(\operatorname{Fr}_X^n\circ v\) are disjoint, where \(\operatorname{Fr}_X\) is the automorphism on \(\bar X\) induced by the inverse of \(x\mapsto x^{\#k_0}\) on \(\bar k_0\). No open immersion or finite type assumption is required.

proof.text: The cardinality equation identifies r with finrank k₀ k₁. The order theorem for finite-field Frobenius implies that a power fixing the embedded field k₁ has exponent divisible by r. Use Module.natCard_eq_pow_finrank and FiniteField.orderOf_frobeniusAlgEquivOfAlgebraic, converting geometric to arithmetic Frobenius by inversion and injectivity of the field embedding. This invokes [lem-sfb-finite-field-galois-frobenius].

proof.text: Suppose the ranges meet and form their intersection pullback. The projection to X followed by c is fixed by Frobenius, so monicity of c identifies the two projections to C. The closure projection equation then gives equality of the two resulting morphisms to Spec k₁.

proof.text: The nonempty intersection maps flatly and surjectively to Spec of the algebraic closure, hence epimorphically. Cancel that map to see that the indicated Frobenius power fixes k₁. This contradicts the nondivisibility hypothesis. The existing APIs are Scheme.Pullback.range_fst_comp, Flat.epi_of_flat_of_surjective, and faithfulness of Spec.

lean.statement:
theorem clopen_sheet_disjoint_pow
    {k₀ k₁ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] [Field k₁] [Finite k₁]
    [Algebra k₀ k₁] {X C : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k₀))] [C.Over (Spec (.of k₁))]
    (c : C ⟶ X) [Mono c] (r : ℕ) (hr : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
    (v : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    (hp : v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberProj =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberProj ≫ c)
    (hb : v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraicClosureAlgEquiv k₀ k₁).symm.toRingHom))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : ¬ r ∣ n) :
    Set.range v.base ∩
      Set.range (v ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ n).hom).base = ∅
